summary: Wrote src/widgets/receptive-field-builder.js. Controls: preset select (one 7x7, three 3x3, VGG blocks 1-2, SmallResNet main path, dilated 1-2-4-8, ResNet stem, plus 'custom' once edited), input size H slider 8-256 (default 64), effective-field toggle (default on), output-unit slider u (also set by clicking the 1D view), and an editable layer table of 1-10 rows (type conv/pool, k in 1,2,3,5,7, s in 1,2,3, d in 1,2,4,8 conv only, p number input with empty = automatic floor(d(k-1)/2), up/down/remove buttons) plus Add layer. Displays: table with H_l, Delta_l, r_l (last row highlighted); SVG 1D cone view with dilated taps in purple and hollow padding taps; canvas 2D map with path-count shading, 50%/90% contours, theoretical-field square, hatched padding, 'in the field but not reached' (gridding) and 'never read' cells; readouts r_L, Delta_L, paths per axis (sci above 1e6), per-axis counts (when 15 or fewer), central w x w share, padding mass, 50%/90% cell counts, and the r_L > H warning. Default is three 3x3, H=64, showing r=3,5,7, counts 1 3 6 7 6 3 1 of 27 and 49.5% (70.4% per axis) in the central 3x3. Numbers checked widget vs independent numpy (matrix-based) Python, all identical: three3x3 H64 (49.5%/70.4%, 13 cells box 5x5 for 50%, 37 cells 7x7 for 90%); one 7x7 (18.4%/42.9%, 49 cells); SmallResNet H64 (r=49, Delta=8, w=25, 72.9%/85.4%, 361/985 cells) and H32 (padding 1.1%, 83.8%/91.5%, 301/717 cells, total 18261 of 19683); dilated 1-2-4-8 (r=31, 42.8%/65.4%, 240/772); four 3x3 d=2 (r=17, counts 1 4 10 16 19 16 10 4 1, 76.8%); VGG blocks (r=16, 77.9%, 40/120); ResNet stem (r=11, 38.3%, 33/105; also H=8 with padding); k2 s3 + 3x3 H20 (r=8, never-read cells, 25.0%); eight 7-tap layers H256 (7^8 = 5.76e6 paths, 95.1%, 145/465; largest per-axis count 398,567 in Python matches spec); ten 7-tap (2.82e8, 97.5%, 185/577); manual p=0 (H_l 62); k5 s2 d4 + k1 s3 + k3 d8 (r=113, 49.0% padding mass, 90% contour unreachable); H=8 extreme; no-valid-output message.
changes: Patched tools/widget-test.mjs so a control that disappears when a widget rebuilds its controls (layer removed) reports 'control gone' instead of crashing the whole test
issues: Both views zoom to a window around the chosen unit's field when H is large (stated in the readout as 'views zoomed to input cells a-b'); the 2D grid is not drawn in full for H > ~3 r_L.

Normalisation convention for padding: total = on-image counts plus all padding mass (taps landing in padding at any layer, not followed further); for interior units this equals the product of kernel sizes. The spec was ambiguous here.
Central-window centre is the unit's position in input coordinates, rounded half up when it falls between cells (even kernels).
At 400 px the layer table scrolls horizontally inside its own container (r_l and buttons are off-screen until scrolled); nothing else overflows.

widget-test.mjs 'changedOutput' flags are unreliable for this widget because rows are rebuilt and toggles are clicked twice; every control was instead verified through widget-probe against Python. The 1D click handler was not driven by a test (the u slider, which sets the same state, was).
The page-level math-i KaTeX spans are not used; headers use plain H_l, Delta_l, r_l.
